verdict.rationale: Migration guidance between major versions is a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents a SolidJS major-version migration guide. One community comment worries about breaking changes in an upcoming 2.0, and another asks for a React-to-Solid migration section, which is a cross-framework topic and not a version upgrade guide.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework
